# sonarqube_qualityprofile_project_association (Resource)

Assigns a quality profile to a project for one language. Import ID: `language/profile/project`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile_project_association" "api" {
  project         = "example-api"
  language        = "java"
  quality_profile = "Company Java"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `language` (String) Language key.
- `project` (String) Project key.
- `quality_profile` (String) Profile name. Changing it reassigns in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualityprofile_project_association.example 'java/Company Java/example-api'
```
